question: On what grounds and with what certainty is the ascertainment said to have been declared?
premises: The ascertainment has been declared by the speaker.
It is declared with devotion and reasoning.
It is declared as without doubt.
inference: With devotion and reasoning, the speaker has declared this ascertainment without doubt.
uncertainties: The content of the ascertainment is not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: Indeed, this ascertainment has been declared by me without doubt, with devotion and reasoning.
